text.text: The scope of physical education includes health-related fitness. What does this primarily focus on?
The ability to perform complex motor skills with precision and grace.
Learning about the history of physical education from ancient Greece to the present day.
Achieving a world-class level of physical performance in a single sport.
The ability to perform daily tasks with vigor and without undue fatigue.

body.text: Health-related focus: tasks with vigour, no fatigue. Skills, history and podiums miss the everyday.

trap.text: Podium tempts as fitness-peak, but health serves daily.

text.text: In the pole vault, what is the 'plant' phase?
The moment the athlete plants their hands on the pole before the jump.
The moment the athlete plants their head on the mat after the jump
The moment the pole is placed in the 'plant box' on the ground.
The moment the athlete plants their feet in the takeoff box to stop their forward motion.

body.text: 'Plant' phase: pole into plant box. Hands, heads and feet miss the slot.

trap.text: Hands tempts as plant-word, but the phase boxes poles.

text.text: Which skill in football is used to legally take the ball away from an opponent?

body.text: Legally takes stated. Passing, heading and dribbling differ.

trap.text: Dribbling tempts as take-on-talk, but taking is tackling.

text.text: Which of the following is a skill-related component of physical fitness that is crucial for a basketball player to quickly change direction?

body.text: Crucial for direction change. Speed, reaction and power serve it.

trap.text: Speed tempts as court-need, but cutting is agility.

text.text: Why do runners try to minimize ground contact time?
To rest longer on each step

body.text: Minimize contact to increase speed. Jumping, resting and saving-energy miss the clock.

trap.text: Saving-energy tempts as economy, but the aim is speed.

text.text: Why do sprinters lean forward during the start?
To look at the finish line

body.text: Lean to push forcefully. Sighting, balance and drag miss the drive.

trap.text: Drag tempts as lean-talk, but crouches launch.

text.text: Which of the following is an example of a healthy fat source for an athlete?

body.text: Healthy fats stated. Fries, margarine and butter-red-meat clog.

trap.text: Butter tempts as fat-food, but healthy is avocado-nuts.

text.text: Which edition of the All Africa Games was the first to include athletes with disabilities?
2015 in Brazzaville, Republic of the Congo

body.text: First with disabilities stated. Harare, Brazzaville and Abuja miss the edition.

trap.text: Abuja tempts as home-games, but first-para is Maputo.

text.text: Which organ is part of both the respiratory and digestive systems?

body.text: Both systems: pharynx. Gullet, voice box and windpipe serve one.

trap.text: Trachea tempts as airway (respiratory only), but dual is pharynx.

text.text: Which badminton grip is used for powerful overhead shots like clears and smashes?
Which somatotype is prone to developing poor posture due to excess body weight and lower muscle tone?

body.text: Prone stated. Ectomorphs, mesomorphs and all-equal miss the mass.

trap.text: All-equal tempts as fairness, but mass slumps endomorph.

text.text: Which of the following is a symptom of drug withdrawal?
An increased appetite and a feeling of being well-rested.
A sudden increase in energy and a feeling of euphoria.
Feeling of calm and relaxation after not taking the drug.
Cravings, sweating, tremors, and anxiety after stopping the drug.

body.text: Withdrawal symptom stated. Appetite, energy and calm invert the crash.

trap.text: Calm tempts as relief-hope, but quitting shakes.

text.text: During physical activity, what is the key role of the trachea in maintaining a high level of performance?
It remains a clear and open airway to facilitate the rapid flow of air.
It helps in the humidification of the air to prevent dehydration.
It contracts to force air out of the lungs more quickly.
It widens to allow a larger volume of air to pass to the lungs.

body.text: Key role: clear airway for rapid flow. Humidifying, squeezing and widening miss the tube.

trap.text: Widening tempts as airflow-talk, but the role is staying open.

text.text: Why is dance important in cultural education?
It promotes only modern Western styles
It preserves and shares cultural heritage

body.text: Important because it preserves heritage. Erasing, scorning and western-only invert it.

trap.text: Western-styles tempt as dance-class, but dance archives.

text.text: Which of the following is NOT an objective of health education?
To promote healthy behaviors and habits.
To develop positive attitudes toward health.

body.text: NOT an objective: diagnosing is clinical. Promoting, informing and attitudes all teach.

trap.text: Informing tempts as objective (it is), but the NOT is diagnosing.

text.text: A key difference between the Greek and Roman philosophy of physical education was that the Greeks valued balance and the Romans valued:

body.text: Romans valued military utility; Greeks balance. Art, intellect and solo pursuits miss the legion.

trap.text: Art tempts as Roman-glory, but PE valued drill.

text.text: Which principle of first aid ensures that the casualty is safe from further harm?
Calling for an ambulance before checking the surroundings.
Removing the casualty from danger if it is safe to do so.
Giving food and water to make the casualty comfortable.

body.text: Principle: remove from danger if safe. Ambulance-first, food-water and hazard-blindness miss the order.

trap.text: Ambulance-first tempts as help-call, but first is safety.

text.text: In which city was the 26th edition of the NUGA Games held in 2022?

body.text: Lagos stated. Abeokuta, Abuja and Benin miss the campus.

trap.text: Abuja tempts as capital-host, but 2022 was Lagos.

text.text: One of the main objectives of first aid is to:

body.text: Objective: prevent further harm. Counselling, curing and surgery exceed the kit.

trap.text: Curing tempts as help-hope, but aid prevents.

text.text: What is the primary characteristic of cancer?
Sudden seizures and loss of consciousness
The abnormal and uncontrolled growth of cells

body.text: Primary characteristic: uncontrolled cell growth. Seizures, lungs and sugar miss the lump.

trap.text: Sugar tempts as disease-talk, but cancer grows.

text.text: Which of the following is a biological factor affecting physical fitness?

body.text: Biological factor: genetics. Media, climate and peers act outside biology.

trap.text: Climate tempts as body-factor, but biological is genes.

text.text: What is a major challenge that both NIPOGA and NATCEGA often face?
Difficulty in finding a host institution.
Lack of interest from students and staff.
Poor funding, inadequate sports facilities, and logistical issues.
Too many athletes wanting to participate.

key_point.text: Poly games beg funds and fields.

body.text: Shared challenge: poor funding, poor facilities, logistics. Hosts, apathy and crowds miss the purse.

trap.text: Apathy tempts as games-worry, but the challenge is funding.

text.text: What is the most effective method for a community to reduce the amount of waste sent to landfills?
Burning all waste in a community incinerator.
Burying all waste in a designated landfill.
Practicing the '3 Rs'-Reduce, Reuse, and Recycle.
Throwing all waste in a public bin.

body.text: Most effective: reduce-reuse-recycle. Burning, burying and binning miss the hierarchy.

trap.text: Burning tempts as disposal, but best is three-Rs.

text.text: Which of the following is a key benefit of participating in NATCEGA?
Promotion of physical fitness and talent identification

body.text: Key benefit stated. Scholarships, light loads and jobs miss the track.

trap.text: Jobs tempt as graduate-hope, but benefit is fitness-plus-talent.

text.text: What is an effective prevention strategy that can be taught in a physical education class?
The importance of developing positive coping mechanisms for stress and pressure.
The importance of not telling anyone about your drug use.
The importance of only using drugs in a safe environment.
The importance of ignoring a person who offers you drugs.

body.text: Effective strategy: positive stress coping. Silence, safe-use and ignoring peddle harm.

trap.text: Ignoring-peddlers tempts as refusal, but strategy is coping.

text.text: The Bata dance of the Yoruba people is traditionally performed to honour which deity?

body.text: Honours thunder god. Obatala, Ogun and Yemoja own other cults.

trap.text: Ogun tempts as Yoruba-god, but Bata is Sango's.

text.text: Which of the following is the best way to care for dry skin?
Using gentle cleansers and moisturizing regularly
Exposing skin to direct sunlight for long hours
Frequent hot water baths and harsh soaps
Avoid washing the skin at all

body.text: Best care stated. Sun, hot-harsh and never-wash harm the barrier.

trap.text: Sun tempts as skin-therapy, but dry wants gentle moisture.

text.text: Which dance from Benue State is known for its elaborate headgear and swift footwork?

body.text: Elaborate headgear plus swift feet stated. Sharo, Koroso and Ekombi belong elsewhere.

trap.text: Koroso tempts as northern-dance, but Benue is Swange.

text.text: What is the function of the valves within the heart?
To produce the electrical impulses that regulate the heart beat.
To prevent the backflow of blood, ensuring it flows in one direction.
To separate the oxygenated blood from the deoxygenated blood.
To produce the 'lub-dub' sound of the heart beat.

body.text: Function: stop backflow. Impulses, separation and sounds belong elsewhere.

trap.text: Separation tempts as heart-anatomy, but valves gate.

text.text: In the case of a chemical burn to the skin, what is the first step you should take?
Immediately flush the area with copious amounts of water.
Neutralize the chemical with a neutralizing agent.
Apply a cold compress to the burn.
Cover the burn with a bandage to contain the chemical.

key_point.text: Chemical burns drown in water first.

body.text: First step: copious flushing. Neutralizers, compresses and covers follow or trap.

trap.text: Neutralizer tempts as chemistry-answer, but first is water.

text.text: Which of these is NOT a component of physical fitness?

body.text: NOT fitness: academic intelligence. Body comp, cardio and flexibility all count.

trap.text: Body-comp tempts as component (it is), but the NOT is grades.

text.text: Which vitamin deficiency is known to cause a condition called Rickets in children, leading to soft bones and deformities?

body.text: Deficiency stated. K, B12 and C miss the bowed legs.

trap.text: C tempts as deficiency-vitamin, but rickets is D.

text.text: Which of these is the best example of an aerobic exercise?
Lifting a very heavy weight once.
Jogging for 30 minutes at a steady pace.

body.text: Best example: 30-minute steady jog. Jumps, lifts and dashes go anaerobic.

trap.text: Sprints tempt as exercise, but aerobic is steady jog.

text.text: Which of these is a key component of a personal health screening that assesses a person's musculoskeletal health?
Flexibility and range of motion tests.

body.text: Musculoskeletal screen stated. Vitals, lungs and BMI screen elsewhere.

trap.text: BMI tempts as body-measure, but joints flex.

text.text: Which tool in a first aid box is used to remove small foreign objects from wounds?

body.text: Tool stated. Scissors, tape and thermometers differ.

trap.text: Scissors tempts as kit-sharp, but splinters need tweezers.

text.text: What type of communicable disease is caused by protozoa?

body.text: Caused type: parasitic infections. Viral, bacterial and fungal differ.

trap.text: Bacterial tempts as germ-talk, but protozoa parasitise.

text.text: In a school setting, what is a key safety practice during emergency drills?
Staying calm and following instructions from teachers
Gathering all personal belongings before leaving
Leaving the building through the main entrance only
Running quickly to the nearest exit

body.text: Key practice: calm plus teacher instructions. Baggage, single doors and sprints endanger.

trap.text: Sprints tempt as evacuation-speed, but drills obey.

text.text: Which of the following is an effective method for controlling minor bleeding from a small cut?
Wrapping the wound in a tight bandage without applying pressure first.
Washing the wound with an antiseptic and then leaving it exposed.
Applying firm pressure to the wound with a clean cloth or bandage.
Applying a tourniquet just above the cut.

body.text: Effective method stated. Tight wraps, open air and tourniquets harm or overdo.

trap.text: Tourniquet tempts as bleeding-tool, but small cuts press.

text.text: Why is dietary fibre an important part of a balanced diet?
It provides a high source of calories.
It is a source of essential amino acids.
It helps regulate digestion and prevents constipation.
It helps the body absorb vitamins more quickly.

body.text: Important because it regulates digestion. Calories, aminos and vitamin-speed miss the broom.

trap.text: Calories tempt as diet-need, but fibre sweeps.

text.text: Why is water important for digestion?
It reduces the need for enzymes.
It creates acids that digest proteins.
It provides the calories needed for digestion.
It softens stool and aids in nutrient absorption.

body.text: Important: softens stool, aids absorption. Enzyme-cuts, acids and calories miss the solvent.

trap.text: Calories tempt as diet-need, but water carries.

text.text: A deficiency in calcium can lead to a condition in which bones become brittle and fragile, a condition known as:

body.text: Brittle-fragile stated: osteoporosis. Goiter, beriberi and pellagra miss the skeleton.

trap.text: Beriberi tempts as deficiency-ill, but brittle is osteoporosis.

text.text: A student misuses an opioid painkiller by taking a higher dose than prescribed. What is a serious and immediate effect this can have on the body?
A sudden increase in muscle strength.
An increase in heart rate and energy.

body.text: Serious immediate effect: respiratory depression. Strength, coordination and energy invert the nod.

trap.text: Energy tempts as drug-rush, but overdose stills breath.

text.text: What corrective exercise principle is essential for improving mobility in stroke survivors?

body.text: Essential principle: task-specific repetitive training. HIIT-only, stretch-only and stillness miss the rewire.

trap.text: Stillness tempts as safety, but recovery repeats.

text.text: Which mental health habit supports good personal health?
Working without rest for long hours.

body.text: Habit stated: seek support overwhelmed. Ignoring, grinding and isolating sink.

trap.text: Grinding tempts as work-ethic, but health asks.

text.text: Which organelle modifies, sorts, and packages proteins for secretion or use within the cell?

body.text: Organelle stated. Mitochondria, cytoplasm and lysosomes differ.

trap.text: Mitochondria tempts as cell-part, but packing is Golgi.

text.text: Which of the following is a sign of overtraining in a strength training programme?

body.text: Sign: persistent soreness plus fatigue. Motivation, sleep and gains invert the slump.

trap.text: Gains tempt as training-proof, but overtraining aches.

text.text: Which muscle is known as the "six-pack" muscle?

body.text: Muscle stated. Femoris, transversus and obliques differ.

trap.text: Obliques tempts as ab-wall, but six-pack is rectus abdominis.

text.text: Which muscle is the largest in the human body?

body.text: Largest stated. Lats, quads and deltoids trail the seat.

trap.text: Quads tempts as big-leg, but largest is gluteus maximus.

text.text: What role does the hypothalamus play in the central nervous system?

body.text: Role: temperature plus hunger. Vision, balance and voluntary motion belong elsewhere.

trap.text: Balance tempts as brain-job, but hunger-heat is hypothalamus.

key_point.text: Ìkọ ọmọ is the children's culture.

body.text: Àṣà ayęyę ọmọdé asks the children's own lore: ìkọ ọmọ. Ìkàwé is literacy, ìkórè harvest produce, ìpẹ̀yà proverbs.

trap.text: Ìpẹ̀yà tempts as oral lore, but children's lore is ìkọ ọmọ.

key_point.text: Sáló means sá asala (picking scattered things).

body.text: Ìtumọ̀ question: sáló is gathering in bits — sá asala. Gbé is carry, kó lọ take away, bọ̀ worship.

trap.text: Kó lọ tempts as taking, but sáló gathers piecemeal.

text.text: "Ę má șe je kí ẹ̀mí yín lè” jé ...

body.text: Ẹ má ṣe jẹ kí ẹ̀mí yín lè counsels restraint — ìmọ̀ràn. Ìbànújẹ is grief, ìrírí experience, àkíyèsí observation.

trap.text: Àkíyèsí tempts as heed-talk, but the utterance advises: ìmọ̀ràn.

text.text: Àyọkà tí ó ni àfihàn àìtọ́ ẹ̀sùn ni ...?
Kì í șe òun ló jà.
Ó dájú pé òun ló jà.
Șé o sọ pé òun ló jà?

key_point.text: Kì í ṣe òun ló jà denies without proof: àfihàn àìtọ́ ẹ̀sùn.

body.text: The verse showing an unproven denial is the bare Kì í ṣe òun. Ó dájú asserts certainty, kó tí ẹnikẹ́ni mọ̀ claims secrecy, ṣé o sọ asks.

trap.text: Ó dájú tempts as courtroom-talk, but unproven denial is the Kì í ṣe form.

text.text: Kí ni àfojúsùn orin ewì to pataki?

body.text: Àfojúsùn orin ewì: the chant teaches — ìkẹ́kọ̀ọ́. Ìkẹ́gàn scorn, ìdárayá entertainment, ìdíje competition miss the purpose.

trap.text: Ìdárayá tempts as song-talk, but ewì instructs.

text.text: Ka àwọn ayokà isàlè yil, ki o si dáhún àwọn ibéèrè tí ó tèlé won. Nínú abúlé aláàánú kan tí ó wà láàárín àwọn òkè aláwo ewé, ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ abàmì kan șẹlẹ̀ tí ó yà àwọn àgbàlagbà abúlé lénu. Ní gbogbo òwúrọ̀, àwọn ará abúlé máa ń jí láti rí pé ọgbà wọn ti bàjẹ́, oúnjẹ wọn sì dínkù láìníye. Ní ìbẹ̀rẹ̀, wọ́n fi sùn kàn àwọn ẹranko igbó. Șùgbọ́n ọdẹ abúlé sọ pé kò sí ipa ẹsẹ̀ kankan tí wọ́n rí láti fihàn pé ẹranko ni . Olórí abúlé pè gbogbo ènìyàn jọ, ó sì dá ẹgbẹ figilanté tó máa ń ṣọ́ alẹ́ sílẹ̀. Àwọn tó yá ara wọn sílẹ̀ fún isé yí mú atupa àti ọpá, wọ́n jókòó nínú òkùnkùn. ọ̀pọ̀ alẹ́ ni kò sí ìșẹ̀lẹ̀ kankan. Șùgbọ́n ní alẹ́ karùn-ún, nígbà tí òșùpá ń tan lójú ọ̀run, won gb kìkún legbeé abà ẹ̀lùbọ̀ olórí abúlé. Wọn sare lọ, wọ́n sì rí àwọn ọmọkùnrin àti ọmọbìnrin kan láti abúlé kejì, tí wọ́n ń sa lọ Ní ọjọ kejì, àwọn àgbàlagbà abúlé lọ sí abúlé yẹn láti bá wọn sọrọ. Ó hàn kedere pé àwọn ọmọ yìí jẹ aláìní, tí ìkànlù omi burúkú kan ti run gbogbo pẹ̀lú oúnję tí wọ́n jí. ọgbà wọn. Kódà, ó jẹ́ pé wọ́n ń jì oúnjẹ kí wọ́n lè yè. Eleyi jẹ̀ ohun ti o bani lọkan jẹ̀, wọn si pinnu láti fi oúnjẹ tí wọ́n ní kù fún wọn dipo ìjíyà. Láti ọjọ́ yẹn lọ, ìbáșepọ̀ àti àjọṣe dájú láàárín àwọn abúlé méjèèjì. Kí ni ișòro tí àwọn ará abúlé kókọ́ dojukọ?
Eranko igbó tí n wọ abúlé wọ́n
Iparun ọgbà àti piparẹ oúnjẹ láìniye

key_point.text: The first problem: ruined farms and vanishing food.

body.text: Passage opens with ọgbà bàjẹ́ and oúnjẹ dínkù every morning. Wild animals were the blamed cause, not the problem; no plague or drought is stated.

trap.text: Ẹranko igbó tempts as the villagers' own blame, but the problem was the ruin itself.

text.text: Ka àwọn ayokà isàlè yil, ki o si dáhún àwọn ibéèrè tí ó tèlé won. Nínú abúlé aláàánú kan tí ó wà láàárín àwọn òkè aláwo ewé, ìșẹ̀lẹ̀ abàmì kan sẹlẹ̀ tí ó yà àwọn àgbàlagbà abúlé lẹ́nu. Ní gbogbo òwúrọ̀, àwọn ará abúlé máa ń jí láti rí pé ọgbà wọn ti bàj, oúnjẹ wọn sì dínkù láìníye. Ní ìbẹ̀rẹ̀, wọ́n fi ẹ̀sùn kàn àwọn ẹranko igbó. Șùgbọ́n ọdẹ abúlé sọ pé kò sí ipa ẹsẹ̀ kankan tí wọ́n rí láti fihàn pé ẹranko ni . Olórí abúlé pè gbogbo ènìyàn jọ, ó sì dá ẹgbẹ figilanté tó máa ń sọ́ alẹ́ sílẹ̀. Àwọn tó yá ara wọn sílẹ̀ fún isé yí mú atupa àti ọpá, wọ́n jókòó nínú òkùnkùn. Òpọ̀ alẹ́ ni kò sí ìșẹ̀l kankan. Șùgbọ́n ní alẹ́ karùn-ún, nígbà tí òșùpá ń tan lójú ọ̀run, won gbó kìkún légbèé abà èlùbọ̀ olórí abúlé. Won sare lọ, wón sì rí àwọn ọmọkùnrin àti ọmọbìnrin kan láti abúlé kejì, tí wọ́n ń sa lọ Ní ọjọ kejì, àwọn àgbàlagbà abúlé lọ sí abúlé yẹn láti bá wọn sọrọ. Ó hàn kedere pé àwọn ọmọ yìí jẹ aláìní, tí ìkànlù omi burúkú kan ti run gbogbo pẹ̀lú oúnjẹ tí wọ́n jí. ọgbà wọn. Kódà, ó jẹ́ pé wọ́n ń jì oúnjẹ kí wọ́n lè yè. Eleyi jẹ̀ ohun ti o bani lọkan jẹ̀, wọn si pinnu láti fi oúnjẹ tí wọ́n ní kù fún wọn dipo ìjíyà. Láti ọjọ́ yẹn lọ, ìbáșepọ̀ àti àjọșe dájú láàárín àwọn abúlé méjèèjì. Ta ni wón kókó fi èsùn kàn pé ó ń bà ogbà wọn jẹ́?

body.text: Ní ìbẹ̀rẹ̀, wọ́n fi ẹ̀sùn kàn àwọn ẹranko igbó — stated verbatim. The other village's children, the hunter and town thieves come later or never.

trap.text: Àwọn ọmọ abúlé míì tempts as the true culprits, but first blamed were animals.

trap.text: Ṣíṣọ́ abúlé tempts as plot-centre, but the theme is mercy.

text.text: Alágbẹ̀dę lásán kì í fi àgùnbánirọ̀ sùn jẹ́ ...?

key_point.text: The blacksmith sleeps not on an anvil: òwe.

body.text: Alágbẹ̀dẹ̀ ... àgùnbánirọ̀ is a proverb (òwe). Èsìn religion, oríkì praise poetry, ewì chant miss the genre.

trap.text: Oríkì tempts as oral-genre, but the saying is òwe.

body.text: Àṣà ayẹyẹ ọmọ tuntun: naming — ìsọmọlórúkọ́. Ìkálẹ̀ counting, ìpẹ̀yà proverbs, ìjíròrò discussion miss it.

trap.text: Ìkálẹ̀ tempts as ceremony-talk, but the rite names the child.

body.text: Synonym question: ìpalára is bodily harm — ìfarapá. Ẹ̀sùn is accusation, ìrun hair, àìlera ill health.

trap.text: Àìlera tempts as harm-adjacent, but ìpalára is injury.

text.text: Yan ọ̀rò tí ó wúlò gégẹ́ bí orúkọ:

key_point.text: Ilé is the noun among verbs.

body.text: Orúkọ hunt: ilé (house) names; kọrin sing, lọ go, jẹ eat act.

trap.text: Kọrin tempts as word-with-object, but only ilé names.

text.text: Kínní ọ̀rọ̀ tí ó jọjú nínú wọ̀nyí?

body.text: Jọjú test: àkọ́lékan, ìkànsí, ìsọdọ̀kan are true compounds; àkọ́lé stands simplex.

trap.text: Àkọ́lékan tempts as near-twin, but àkọ́lé is the simplex.

text.text: Èdá ìbílẹ̀ Yoruba ní a mọ̀ sí ...?

body.text: Èdá ìbílẹ̀: òrìṣà. Ìbèbè fan, ègún masquerade/ancestor, ẹ̀jẹ̀ blood miss it.

trap.text: Ègún tempts as spirit-talk, but deity is òrìṣà.

text.text: Kínní apẹẹrẹ ọ̀rọ̀ orúkọ tí a fọwọ́ jẹ?

body.text: Fọwọ́-jẹ (tangible) noun: ọkọ̀ ayọ́kẹ́lẹ́ (car). Odò river, ọkọ hoe/vehicle-stem and mọ know are vague or verbal.

trap.text: Ọkọ̀ tempts as vehicle-word, but the tangible full noun is ọkọ̀ ayọ́kẹ́lẹ́.

text.text: Àwọn tó máa ń kọ orin ìjálá ni ...?

body.text: Ìjálá is the hunters' chant — ọdẹ. Awako, hunters'-praise-singers' leaders aside, ọkànsósó and ọlọ́jà miss it.

trap.text: Awako tempts as chant-leader, but the singers are ọdẹ.

text.text: Ninu lẹ́tà aigbefe, adiresi keji gbodo je ti ...?

body.text: Lẹ́tà áìgbèfẹ́: adírẹ́sì kejì belongs to ẹni tí a kọ sí. Writer, posting place and child miss it.

trap.text: Alákọ̀wé tempts as letter-party, but the second address receives.

text.text: Ìbílẹ̀ Yoruba maa ń fọwọ́ sí ìgbéyàwó ...?

body.text: Ìgbéyàwó binds families — ìdílé. Ọ̀gbẹ́ni, alákòóso and the couple-alone miss the communal scope.

trap.text: Ẹlẹ́ni méjì tempts as couple-talk, but marriage joins houses.

text.text: Kínní ọ̀rò ìșọ̀kan nínú ìpẹ̀yà yìí: Bí ọmọdé bá mọ̀wé, kó má mọ̀ ọ̀nà àtàwọn àgbà, ó yẹ kí ó fi ọwọ́ bọlẹ̀ fún wọn.

body.text: Ìṣọ̀kan hunt in the sentence: ó links clauses. Mọ̀ ọ̀nà, kó and mọ̀wé are verbs/phrases.

trap.text: Kó tempts as linker-look, but the conjunction is ó.

text.text: Èrí tí a fi ń mọ ọmọ deledele ni ...?

key_point.text: A true child is known by oríkì.

body.text: Ẹ̀rí ọmọ: oríkì (praise lineage). Àjọ meeting, ìlànà rule, orúkọ bare name miss the proof.

trap.text: Orúkọ tempts as identity, but proof of belonging is oríkì.

text.text: "Bi esin ba dani mole, a a tun gun ni." je

body.text: Bí ẹṣin bá dáni mọ́lẹ̀ ... states a general explanation — àlàyé. Ìmúlò usage, ẹ̀kúnrẹ́rẹ́ detail and àmọ̀ràn advice miss the slot.

trap.text: Àmọ̀ràn tempts as proverb-purpose, but the form here explains.

text.text: Èrọ tí a fi túmọ̀ ọ̀rọ̀ kúrò ní èdè kan sí èkejì ni ...?

body.text: Èrọ translation: atúmọ̀ (dictionary). Èrọ ayọkà reader, ìtúmọ̀ the act, ọ̀rọ̀ èdè speech miss the tool.

trap.text: Ìtúmọ̀ tempts as translation-word, but the tool is atúmọ̀.

text.text: Kínní àtẹ̀le ọ̀rọ̀ yìí: Mo n lọ sí ilé ìwòsàn ...
mo n lọ sí ilé ìjọsìn

key_point.text: Hospital is for ailment: nítorí pé mo ní àìlera.

body.text: Àtẹ̀le: reason-clause completes hospital-going — àìlera. Church, loitering and herbs miss the fit.

trap.text: Ewé tempts as hospital-adjacent, but reason-fit is ailment.

text.text: Onkọwe tí o kọ Ogboju Ode Ninu Igbo Irunmole ni ...?

body.text: Literary fact: Fágúnwà authored it. Fálétì, Ògúnmọ́lá and Òsófisan belong to other works.

trap.text: Fálétì tempts as Yoruba-author, but Ogboju Ọdẹ is Fágúnwà's.

text.text: Èsẹ̀ tí o wulo gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìtàn èdè ni ...?

body.text: Ìtàn-èdè in verse: news-carrying chant — ewì oníròyìn. Ìjìnlẹ̀ depth, àlàyé prose and ìgbálẹ̀ sweeping miss it.

trap.text: Àlàyé tempts as history-talk, but verse-history is ewì oníròyìn.

text.text: Kínní orúkọ tí a fi șe àfihàn àjọpọ̀ ènìyàn?

body.text: Àjọpọ̀ ènìyàn marker: àwọn ará. Bàbá, ìyá, ọmọ name members.

trap.text: Ọmọ tempts as people-word, but the collective is àwọn ará.

text.text: Èsìn àti àșà se e túmọ̀ nínú ...?

body.text: Túmọ̀ slot: àlàyé (expository prose). Ìtàn history, arẹ̀kẹ́rẹ́ panegyric, eré play miss it.

trap.text: Ìtàn tempts as culture-talk, but the expository form is àlàyé.

text.text: Kínní ipa ọ̀rọ̀ "jẹ" nínú gbolohun Mo jẹ àkara lọ́jọ́ yẹn?

body.text: Ipa ọ̀rọ̀ jẹ in Mo jẹ àkara: it predicates — iṣẹ́. Àsọyé explanation, àpẹẹrẹ example, orúkọ noun miss it.

trap.text: Orúkọ tempts as word-class, but jẹ acts as verb.

text.text: Àșà ọjọ́ ibi nínú àșà Yoruba ni ...?

body.text: Ọjọ́ ìbí rite: àrìyá (celebration). Ìlú town, ìtàn history, ìtẹ̀gùn support miss it.

trap.text: Ìtàn tempts as custom-talk, but birthday is àrìyá.

text.text: Eré tí ó ní ètò ìsin

key_point.text: Timed play has ìsìn rules: eré tí ó ní ètò ìsin.

body.text: Eré onígbàgbọ́: game bound by turns — ètò ìsìn. Curriculum games, sung news and life stories miss it.

trap.text: Ìtàn ayé tempts as tale-talk, but timed play is turn-bound.

text.text: Kí ni ọ̀rọ̀ àpẹẹrẹ nínú gbolohun: Òjò ń rọ bí i pé ọ̀run ń șú?

key_point.text: The exemplar is bí i pé.

body.text: Ọ̀rọ̀ àpẹẹrẹ in the simile: bí i pé. Òjò, rọ̀, ọ̀run are sentence parts.

trap.text: Òjò tempts as subject, but the comparative is bí i pé.

key_point.text: Oríkì is ìyìn ẹni (praise of a person).

body.text: Definition: oríkì praises — ìyìn ẹni. Ìròyìn news, àlàyé prose, ìmọ̀ ayé knowledge miss it.

trap.text: Ìròyìn tempts as oral-word, but oríkì praises.

body.text: Àpẹẹrẹ ìjálá: praise of the brave — ìyìn akíkanjú. Pastime songs, occult tales and work songs miss it.

trap.text: Orin ìdárayá tempts as song, but ìjálá praises bravery.

text.text: Choose the word with the same vowel sound as the underlined letters in: pour.

body.text: *Ore* /ɔː/ matches. *Hour* (/aʊə/), *how* (/aʊ/) and *favour* (/eɪ/) are the *our*-spelling traps.
